## You can see what kind of agent is running

- **A subagent's type now shows up next to its name.** A child spawned with its own task label used to read `@ron — pitty-install-plugins`, which told you its name and its errand but never what kind of agent it was. It now reads `@ron · implementer — pitty-install-plugins` — sidebar rows, spawn group rows, spawn cards, the inspector header, and the subagent selector.
- **The type is the part that always survives.** It sits first and the descriptive label follows, so the sidebar's narrow row clip shortens the label and keeps the type.
- **The sidebar count no longer disappears.** With children running, the `Subagents (N active)` header used to lose its number to the inspection hint on the same row and render as `Subagents (2`. The count is now the part that stays, and the hint clips instead.

## Compatibility

- No configuration changes, and nothing changes about how runs are detected or controlled. This is display only.

## Validation

- PiTTy typecheck passed; complete local suite: **439 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed**. The new sidebar-header test fails when its fix is removed.
